claim: Sponsor survey respondents self-rated grant review highly effective (86pct) compared with solicitation (34pct)
material_limit: Self report, selection bias, no cost measured
reconsider_when: New independent data contradicts survey coding/denominator

claim: Grant review is inexpensive and already solved
measurement_unit: Costs, quality, and workflow in sponsor operations
material_limit: Perceived effectiveness not per-grant costs, control quality, or 2026 performance
current_justified_use: Do not claim; collect time/exception records
reconsider_when: Representative grant audit reveals actual high or low fully loaded cost

claim: Engagement/solicitation tools are commercially more attractive than grant vetting
measurement_unit: Actual sponsor procurement/WTP and workflow outcomes
material_limit: Survey difference not proof of buyer budgets or product ROI
current_justified_use: Experimental discovery only, no product build commitment
reconsider_when: Current buyer interviews or trial data strongly favor grant-review automation

claim: DAFRC revised FY2024 reports about 3.59m accounts across heterogenous sponsor categories and donation processor growth
measurement_unit: US IRS Schedule D all sponsor account categories
material_limit: Reported accounts not unique people, not active investment account necessarily
reconsider_when: New revised official dataset replaces totals or grouping

claim: 3.59m DAF accounts are paying enterprise platform software customers
time_scope: FY2024 vs current enterprise platform market
measurement_unit: Sponsor DAF accounts versus distinct vendor customer legal entities
material_limit: A DAF account not equivalent to a paying enterprise contract
reconsider_when: Matched contract records establish narrow active billed accounts with defensible denominator

claim: DAF technology enterprise TAM can now be quantified from public account count alone
measurement_unit: Unique external platform customers × price and cost
material_limit: Needs buyer/contract incidence and monetization by product type
current_justified_use: Strategic: do not publish numeric TAM yet
reconsider_when: Revised sponsor-level classifications and paid contract data are reconciled

claim: RCF audited statements disclose 2024 19225546 USD paid to Ren
measurement_unit: Named RCF charitable sponsor expense paid to Ren services provider
material_limit: This is not consolidated company revenue or standalone software profit
reconsider_when: Auditor restatement or sponsor amended financials

claim: Charityvest paid Foundation Source precisely 811940 USD in 2024
measurement_unit: Total other-than-grants charity expense residual versus unnamed technology payee
material_limit: Payee not named and amount includes non-vendor expenses; original 2024 audit unreviewed
reconsider_when: Audited named service payee note identifies actual amount

claim: Ren profit margin is greater than Foundation Source profit margin
measurement_unit: Two for-profit vendors; company-recognized revenue and cost
material_limit: No matched revenue, cost, provider scope, adjusted acquisition/related-party facts
reconsider_when: Same-period audited vendor financials and comparable service cost are available

claim: Ren has one directly observed material sponsor-admin fee payment stream whereas FS named Charityvest transfer is not verified
measurement_unit: RCF-to-Ren named payee versus Charityvest aggregated cost categories
material_limit: Strength of *evidence*, not necessarily economic advantage
current_justified_use: Report Ren evidence lead without profitability assertion
reconsider_when: Charityvest audit supplies directly comparable named payee fee series
